profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies describes itself as a provider of technology solutions, services and support. Its website lists products including laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming and accessories. The site promotes Copilot+ PCs as combining powerful performance, built-in intelligence, and all-day battery life, and describes Dell Premier as a way for organizations to customize their entire IT experience.

The company is a public company founded in 1984, headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, United States, and trades under the ticker DELL with CIK 0001571996. It has 126 legal matters recorded in Texas. The site states a 30-day return period calculated from invoice date, with exceptions to Dell's standard return policy.
